items.name: Basic Prompting
items.summary: Perform basic prompting with an OpenAI model.

items.name: Blog Writer
items.summary: Write blog posts from web references using an Agent. URL fetches references, you provide the topic via Chat Input, and the Agent writes a grounded post. Core components only.

items.name: Content Aggregator
items.summary: Aggregate recent content on a topic: Web Search (News) gathers articles, a Batch Run summarizes each one, and an Agent curates them into a clean digest that is shown and saved to a file.

items.name: Custom Component Generator
items.summary: Describe a Langflow component and an Agent generates its Python code. The Agent fetches Langflow reference code on demand with a URL tool and remembers the conversation with a Memory tool.

items.name: Deep Research Agent
items.summary: Ask a research question and get a thorough, synthesized answer. Three Agents collaborate: a planner, a web researcher (core Web Search), and a synthesizer.

items.name: Document Q&A
items.summary: Ask questions about your own document using a built-in Knowledge Base (RAG). File ingests into the KB; an Agent answers from retrieved context. No external vector database required.

items.name: Financial Report Parser
items.summary: Upload a financial report; an Agent extracts key metrics (Gross Profit, EBITDA, Net Income, ...) as structured output. Core components only - the Agent's built-in structured output replaces the Structured Output component; File replaces pasted text.

items.name: Hybrid Search RAG
items.summary: Self-contained hybrid RAG on one canvas: an ingestion branch (File -> Split Text -> Astra DB) to populate the collection, and a search branch (semantic vector + keyword lexical, reranked) where an Agent extracts the lexical keywords.

items.name: Image Sentiment Analysis
items.summary: Upload an image; a vision Language Model classifies its sentiment (positive/negative/neutral) and briefly describes it. The Language Model receives the image natively, so the model actually sees it.

items.name: Instagram Copywriter
items.summary: Generate an Instagram caption + image prompt from a topic. A two-Agent chain: a Caption Agent researches the topic with the core Web Search tool (DuckDuckGo, no key) and writes the caption, then an Image Agent appends a matching image prompt. No prompt templates, bundle-free, all on the Agent core.

items.name: Knowledge Retrieval
items.summary: An example of performing a vector search against data in a Knowledge Base to retrieve relevant documents.

items.name: Market Research
items.summary: Research a company and extract a structured profile (pricing, plans, market, features, target industries).

items.name: Meeting Summary
items.summary: Transcribe a meeting (custom AssemblyAI Transcriber using the current API), summarize it with a Summary Agent, and chat about it with a Chat Agent grounded in the transcript and backed by Memory.

items.name: Memory Chatbot
items.summary: Create a chatbot that saves and references previous messages, enabling the model to maintain context throughout the conversation.

items.name: Multi Agent Flow
items.summary: A three-step chain of specialist Agents (Innovator -> Analyst -> Product Manager) that turns a market trend into a product concept, an evaluation, and a development plan.

items.name: Portfolio Website Code Generator
items.summary: Upload a resume and an Agent generates a single-page portfolio website (HTML/CSS).

items.name: Price Deal Finder
items.summary: A Price Deal Finder Agent: searches the web (incl. coupon news), reads listings (URL), computes savings (Calculator) and remembers your watchlist (Memory), returning the best deals as a structured table.

items.name: Research Translation Loop
items.summary: This template iterates over search results using LoopComponent and translates each result into Portuguese automatically. 🚀

items.name: SaaS Pricing
items.summary: Calculate the optimal monthly SaaS subscription price from costs, margin, and subscriber estimate. The Agent uses its built-in calculator and can optionally query the user's own database via a SQL Database tool.

items.name: SEO Keyword Generator
items.summary: Generates targeted SEO keywords based on product information, pain points, and customer profiles for strategic marketing.

items.name: Sequential Tasks Agents
items.summary: A generic three-step agent pipeline: a Research Agent (Web Search) gathers information, an Analysis Agent analyzes it, and a Writer Agent synthesizes both into a final report. Generalized from the finance-specific original;

items.name: Simple Agent
items.summary: A starter Agent with tools: core Web Search (find info) and URL (read a page), plus the Agent's built-in calculator and current-date tools.

items.name: Social Media Agent
items.summary: A general social-media research Agent: it searches the web (core Web Search) and reads pages (core URL tool) to gather current information, then completes your task. Replaces the Apify google-search and TikTok scraper tools with core tools.

items.name: Text Sentiment Analysis
items.summary: Upload a text file and analyze its sentiment two ways: a direct analysis and a summarize-then-analyze pass.

items.name: Travel Planning Agents
items.summary: Three Agents plan a trip: research the destination (core Web Search), draft the itinerary (URL), and budget it (Calculator).

items.name: Twitter Thread Generator
items.summary: Generate an engaging tweet or Twitter thread from a project brief. An Agent (replacing the Language Model) follows the Prompt's style guidelines as its system prompt and writes from the Chat Input context. Core components only, bundle-free.

items.name: Vector Store RAG
items.summary: Load your data for chat context with Retrieval Augmented Generation.
